package consumer

import (
	"context"
	di "github.com/cratis/fundamentals.go/dependencyinjection"
)

// RegisterForeign witnesses another generator's registration ownership, not
// actual Chronicle generator output. Arc is told its exact key and lifetime.
func RegisterForeign(r di.Registrar) error {
	return di.Bind(r, di.Singleton, func(context.Context, di.Resolver) (*Foo, error) { return NewFoo(), nil })
}
